verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail exposes an MCP server and an agent builder, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never documents a sandbox, test account, or isolated non-production environment. Explicit approval of each send action is an adjacent safety control, not sandbox isolation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
